text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself to the absolute limit, 
Winning Ticket managed to seize victory 
over Narita Taishin.

Meanwhile, rather than the anticipated 
showdown between rivals, the spectators 
found themselves captivated by Narita 
Taishin's fiercely spirited running.

Determined not to lose to Narita Taishin, 
Winning Ticket boosted her motivation to 
work even harder.

Fired up, Winning Ticket set her sights on 
the grand stage that caps off the first 
half of the Twinkle Series: the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
